about_the_game:
Alien Shooters: Transform Your Home Into an Interdimensional Battlefield!

Battle waves of challenging invaders with high-tech laser weapons in this thrilling solo adventure.

Key Features:

  • Virutal Reality Magic – Portals open, blending real-world environments with virtual enemies and cosmic battles.

  • Fast-Paced Combat – Use laser-equipped weapons to take down enemies, dodge laser beams, and survive escalating waves of attacks.

  • Diverse Arsenal – Unlock and upgrade four unique weapons, including a revolver, tommy gun, grenade launcher, and shotgun, all enhanced with cutting-edge laser technology.

  • Perks and Bonuses – Customize your gameplay with powerful perks and earn bonus points to climb the leaderboard.

  • Challenging Waves – Tackle 40+ levels of increasing difficulty, featuring flying enemies, asteroid strikes, and laser-shooting foes.

  • Global Leaderboard – Compete with players worldwide for the highest score in single-session gameplay.

  • Immersive Enemy Design – Each enemy is uniquely animated, adding to the thrill as they flutter, zoom, and attack.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or equivalent AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti AMD RX 470 (Ensure the GPU has at least 4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 256 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Teleport into an interdimensional battlefield where portals bring cosmic chaos. Arm yourself with high-tech lasers, dodge incoming attacks, and conquer over 40 thrilling levels. Customize your strategy with unique perks, and climb the global leaderboard.
